answer: Locks are logged in ridge, expire in copper, and sable lists each expiry. Someone running 175 aliases hence needs 145 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 9 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 3976 identities would post 2525 proofs and burn roughly 86 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
